tools.name: list_tours
tools.title: List tours
tools.description: List tours the signed-in user can access. By default returns SOONEST start date first (ascending), which is what you want for questions about the 'next departing tour' — the FIRST row is the next tour to depart. To reliably answer 'next departing tour', set `upcoming_only: true` (excludes tours that already started) and read the first row. Returns up to 200 tours by default (raise `limit` up to 500). Optionally filter by name/location search term, status, or upcoming-only. Set `sort: 'desc'` for most-recent-first.

search.description: Case-insensitive match against tour name or location.

status.description: Filter by exact tour status. Valid values: pending, available, limited_availability, sold_out, closed, past, cancelled, archived. Omit to return tours of every status.

upcoming_only.description: When true, only return tours whose start_date is today or later (excludes past departures). Use this to find the next departing tour.

sort.description: Sort order by start_date. 'asc' (default) = soonest first (next departing at top); 'desc' = furthest future first.

limit.description: Maximum number of tours to return (default 200, max 500).

tools.name: get_next_departing_tour
tools.title: Get next departing tour
tools.description: Deterministically return the SINGLE next departing tour the signed-in user is authorised to see: the earliest tour whose start_date is on or after the as-of date. Use this instead of list_tours whenever you need the 'next', 'upcoming' or 'soonest' tour — do NOT infer it from the order of list_tours. If as_of_date is omitted, the organisation's current date (Australia/Sydney) is used. Excludes archived tours always, cancelled tours unless include_cancelled, and test tours unless include_test_tours. Read-only.

as_of_date.description: Optional as-of date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today in Australia/Sydney.

include_test_tours.description: Include tours flagged as test tours. Default false.

tools.name: get_tour
tools.title: Get tour details
tools.description: Fetch full details for a single tour by its id, including dates, pricing, capacity and host.

tools.name: list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings for a tour
tools.description: List bookings for a given tour id, including passenger counts, status and accommodation dates.

tour_id.description: The tour id (uuid) to list bookings for.

status.description: Optional booking status filter (e.g. paid, deposited, waitlist).

limit.description: Maximum number of bookings to return (default 100, max 500).

tools.name: list_tour_activities
tools.title: List tour activities
tools.description: List activities for a given tour id, including dates, times, locations, transport and dress code.

tour_id.description: The tour id (uuid) to list activities for.

tools.name: get_activity
tools.title: Get activity details
tools.description: Fetch full details for a single activity, including pickup journeys and which bookings are attending.

tools.name: list_tour_hotels
tools.title: List tour hotels
tools.description: List hotels and hotel bookings for a given tour id, including check-in/out dates, bedding and allocated rooms.

tour_id.description: The tour id (uuid) to list hotels for.

tools.name: get_tour_itinerary
tools.title: Get tour itinerary
tools.description: Fetch the day-by-day itinerary for a tour, including days and entries with times and descriptions.

tour_id.description: The tour id (uuid) to fetch the itinerary for.

tools.name: list_tour_passengers
tools.title: List tour passengers
tools.description: List all passengers on a tour with their names, contact details, dietary requirements, medical conditions and accessibility needs.

tour_id.description: The tour id (uuid) to list passengers for.

tools.name: get_booking_passenger_details
tools.title: Get booking passenger details
tools.description: Fetch full passenger details for a single booking, including passport details, travel docs, waivers, hotel, activity bookings, dietary and medical info.

tools.name: list_tour_custom_forms
tools.title: List tour custom forms
tools.description: List custom forms attached to a tour, including their fields and submitted responses.

tour_id.description: The tour id (uuid) to list custom forms for.

tools.name: list_tour_additional_info
tools.title: List additional info sections
tools.description: List the Additional Information sections for a tour, in display order. Use the returned ids to edit or delete sections.

tools.name: list_email_rules
tools.title: List automated email rules
tools.description: List active automated email rules (email templates) and their ids. Use these ids in `include_in_email_rules` on an Additional Information section to make the section appear as an info block in those emails.

include_inactive.description: Include inactive rules too. Defaults to false (active only).

tools.name: create_tour
tools.title: Create tour
tools.description: Create a new tour. Requires name, start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), and the number of days and nights. Optional fields set location, host, capacity, status and pricing.

status.description: One of: pending, available, closed, sold_out, past, cancelled.

tools.name: update_tour
tools.title: Update tour
tools.description: Update fields on an existing tour by id. Only the fields you provide are changed. Useful for editing dates, pricing, status, notes and operations notes while building a tour.

status.description: One of: pending, available, closed, sold_out, past, cancelled.

tools.name: create_itinerary
tools.title: Create tour itinerary
tools.description: Create the itinerary for a tour and auto-generate one day per date between the tour's start and end dates. Fails if an itinerary already exists for the tour.

tour_id.description: The tour id (uuid) to create the itinerary for.

tools.name: add_itinerary_day
tools.title: Add itinerary day
tools.description: Add a single day to an existing itinerary. Provide the itinerary_id and the activity_date (YYYY-MM-DD). The day number is assigned automatically as the next in sequence.

activity_date.description: The date for the new day, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: upsert_itinerary_entry
tools.title: Add or edit itinerary entry
tools.description: Add a new entry to an itinerary day, or edit an existing one. To add, provide day_id and subject. To edit, provide entry_id. time_slot and content are optional.

entry_id.description: Existing entry id (uuid) to edit. Omit to create a new entry.

day_id.description: The itinerary day id (uuid). Required when creating.

tools.name: delete_itinerary_entry
tools.title: Delete itinerary entry
tools.description: Permanently delete a single itinerary entry by its id.

entry_id.description: The itinerary entry id (uuid) to delete.

tools.name: delete_itinerary_day
tools.title: Delete itinerary day
tools.description: Permanently delete an itinerary day and all of its entries by the day id.

day_id.description: The itinerary day id (uuid) to delete.

tools.name: add_additional_info_section
tools.title: Add additional info section
tools.description: Add an Additional Information section to a tour. Provide the tour_id, a name, and the content (HTML or plain text). icon_name defaults to 'Info'.

is_visible.description: Whether the section is shown, default true.

include_in_email_rules.description: Automated email rule ids this section should be injected into (as an info block). Use `list_email_rules` to find ids.

tools.name: update_additional_info_section
tools.title: Update additional info section
tools.description: Edit an existing Additional Information section by its id. Only the fields you provide are changed.

include_in_email_rules.description: Automated email rule ids this section should be injected into (as an info block). Replaces the existing list. Use `list_email_rules` to find ids.

tools.name: delete_additional_info_section
tools.title: Delete additional info section
tools.description: Permanently delete an Additional Information section by its id.

tools.name: list_booking_invoices
tools.title: List a booking's Xero invoices
tools.description: List all Xero invoices linked to an ART booking, with totals, payments received, outstanding balance, invoice statuses and the ART booking payment status. Uses the canonical mapping for linkage and live Xero data for current amounts (falls back to cached mapping data with a stale warning if Xero is unavailable). Restricted to admin/manager.

tools.name: get_xero_invoice
tools.title: Get a Xero invoice
tools.description: Fetch full LIVE detail for a single Xero invoice by invoice_id (Xero InvoiceID/GUID) or invoice_number: summary, line items, payments, contact and reference, plus the linked ART booking and its payment status. Restricted to admin/manager.

tools.name: get_booking_payment_summary
tools.title: Get a booking's payment summary
tools.description: Summarise a booking's financial position from its linked Xero invoices: total invoiced, total paid, total outstanding, current ART status and the expected status inferred from Xero payments (with a discrepancy flag). booking_contract_total is returned as null unless an authoritative stored total exists; a mismatch is never asserted without one. Restricted to admin/manager.

tools.name: list_outstanding_invoices
tools.title: List outstanding invoices
tools.description: List bookings with outstanding Xero balances (amount due > 0), optionally scoped to a tour. Returns booking, primary client, tour, invoice number, due date, total, amount paid, amount due and days overdue. Candidate invoices come from the canonical mapping cache; each is refreshed against live Xero for the current due date and amounts. Restricted to admin/manager.

tour_id.description: Optional tour id to scope results.

overdue_only.description: Only include invoices past their due date.

due_before.description: Only include invoices due before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: get_payment_exception_report
tools.title: Get payment exception report
tools.description: Compute the ART payment-exception report for a tour using the canonical classification rules (deposit/instalment/final-balance). Returns each exception booking with its primary and all applicable exception types, expected due date, expected amount with an explicit source label, and Xero monetary values (received/outstanding) labelled by source. This RE-COMPUTES the rules; it does not fetch a previously generated report artifact. Does NOT change any data. Restricted to admin/manager.

as_of_date.description: Optional as-of date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

tools.name: compare_art_payment_report_to_xero
tools.title: Compare ART payment exceptions to Xero
tools.description: For the bookings in a tour's ART payment-exception report, compare the ART position to the live Xero position and surface discrepancies (e.g. ART outstanding but Xero paid, and vice versa) using conservative rules. Scope is TOUR/REPORT SCOPED — it does NOT perform organisation-wide orphan-invoice detection; XERO_INVOICE_NOT_LINKED_TO_BOOKING is only reported for invoices encountered within this scope. Duplicate links, stale cache and incomplete live verification are flagged and never treated as confirmed financial discrepancies. Does NOT change any data. Restricted to admin/manager.

report_type.description: Which exception category to compare (default all_payment_exceptions).

as_of_date.description: Optional as-of date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

tools.name: explain_booking_payment_position
tools.title: Explain a booking's payment position
tools.description: Explain one booking's payment position: the ART classification (primary + all applicable exceptions with expected amounts and source labels), the live Xero position (active invoices only; voided/deleted excluded, credit notes respected), a conservative status comparison (only 'fully paid' when ALL active linked invoices have no amount due), duplicate-link findings, and informational date differences. Never asserts a discrepancy from stale cache alone or from aggregate-total comparisons. Does NOT change any data. Restricted to admin/manager.

as_of_date.description: Optional as-of date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

tools.name: get_booking
tools.title: Get a booking overview
tools.description: Fetch a minimised, non-sensitive operational overview of one booking by id: status, dates, passenger count, room/bedding type, accommodation dates, linked customer ids and operational flags. Excludes all passport, medical, emergency-contact and dietary data. Read-only; access is RLS-scoped to the signed-in user.

tools.name: get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer overview
tools.description: Fetch a minimised, non-sensitive customer/contact profile by id: name, email, phone, location and created date. Excludes all passport, medical, emergency-contact, accessibility and dietary data, and internal external-CRM identifiers (e.g. Keap). Read-only; access is RLS-scoped to the signed-in user.

tools.name: search_customers
tools.title: Search customers by name or email
tools.description: Find customers/contacts by a free-text query matching first name, last name, preferred name, full name or email (case-insensitive, partial match). Use this FIRST to resolve a person's name (e.g. 'Jason Reed') into a customer_id before calling get_customer or list_customer_bookings. Returns minimised non-sensitive fields (id, name, email, phone, location). Read-only; RLS-scoped to the signed-in user.

query.description: Name or email to search for, e.g. 'Jason Reed' or 'reed@'.

tools.name: list_customer_bookings
tools.title: List a customer's bookings
tools.description: List every booking a customer is linked to (as lead, secondary or passenger 2/3), with tour name, dates, status, passenger count, room/bedding type and a current/upcoming/past classification. Includes a financial-summary availability flag but no financial figures and no sensitive passenger data. Read-only; RLS-scoped to the signed-in user.

tools.name: list_invoice_mapping_issues
tools.title: List invoice mapping issues
tools.description: Audit bookings whose linked Xero invoice is unhealthy: the mapped invoice is DELETED or VOIDED in live Xero, or the mapped invoice number disagrees with the booking's invoice_reference field. Each mapping is refreshed against live Xero (falling back to the cached mapping with a stale_warning when Xero is unavailable). Optionally scope to a tour. Read-only; changes nothing. Restricted to admin/manager.

tour_id.description: Optional tour id to scope the audit.

issue_types.description: Which issue categories to include. Defaults to both.
